# Q1 pair-local weight expansion experiment

Isolated from runtime9daba5511. Keep the proven two-row dispatch and all
8 activation pairs live across rows. Replace the per-row array of 8 expanded
weight pairs with immediate expansion/consumption in the same 8 ordered
dots. Scale/range repair, reduction and accumulation remain unchanged.
The current kernel uses48 VGPRs and its body accounts for60.4% of profiled
decode device time. Four-row reuse raised VGPRs to64 and lost4.03% decode.
This tests whether shortening weight lifetimes helps without increasing
row count. It differs from the earlier rejected one-row streamed-pair trial,
which moved activation reads into the pair loop as well.

No speed/correctness claim before native checks and matched timings. Keep
all calls and activity. Only a winning screen merits depth identity checks.
